usage.label: adjust to + N/V-ing
usage.explanationZh: 使自己適應……；＝adapt (oneself) to + N/V-ing；＝accustom oneself to + N/V-ing。

usage.label: commit, committed, committed
usage.explanationZh: commit 的過去式和過去分詞為 committed。

usage.label: commit A to B
usage.explanationZh: 將 A 奉獻於 B；＝devote A to B；＝dedicate A to B。

usage.label: furnish sb with sth
usage.explanationZh: 提供某人某物；＝provide sb with sth。

usage.label: appoint sb to + V
usage.explanationZh: 指定某人從事……；＝assign sb to + V。

usage.label: appoint sb as + 職位
usage.explanationZh: 指派某人擔任……職位；＝assign sb (to be) + 職位。

usage.label: an instrument panel
usage.explanationZh: （機器、設備等的）儀表板（正式說法）。

usage.label: expose A to B
usage.explanationZh: 使 A 暴露於 B；使 A 接觸 B。

usage.label: shift A to B
usage.explanationZh: 把 A 轉移給 B。

usage.label: shift one's attention from A to B
usage.explanationZh: 把某人的注意力從 A 轉到 B；＝change one's attention from A to B。

usage.label: work on the day / night shift
make a resolution to + V
usage.explanationZh: 下定決心要……；＝make a promise to + V；＝resolve to + V；＝determine to + V；＝make up one's mind to + V。

usage.label: A be composed of B
usage.explanationZh: A 由 B 組成；＝A be made up of B；＝A consist of B；＝B compose A。
